item.title: @elysiabiro is a pianist and songwriter from Vancouver Island wh...
item.description: @elysiabiro is a pianist and songwriter from Vancouver Island whose smooth-listening, jazz-infused pop has earned millions of streams.She also shares her love of jazz through her social media series “Transcription Tuesday,” where she pays tribute to the legendary pianists who shaped her by transcribing their solos.She joined guest host @gilldeacon to talk about her latest single, Reignite. Listen to the full interview on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, or wherever you get your podcasts. Link in bio.
